title: GRAPHIC DESIGN TECHNOLOGY AND PRODUCTION 1
description: The first of a two-course series covering software skills and production techniques aimed at building a confident understanding and demonstration of the tools of design, making, craft, and delivery.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
